vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: attio-cli
Version: 1.0.0

The skill is classified as suspicious primarily due to the supply chain risk introduced by its installation instructions in `SKILL.md`. It directs the agent to `git clone` and `npm install` from an external GitHub repository (`https://github.com/FroeMic/attio-cli`). `npm install` can execute arbitrary code via package scripts, posing a risk if the upstream repository is compromised or malicious. While the `scripts/generate-schema.sh` file and other instructions appear to align with the stated purpose of interacting with Attio CRM, the reliance on an external, potentially untrusted source for installation elevates the risk beyond benign.
